transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

At work my mind jumps to every little thing going on around me, and I lose track of what I’m doing in the middle of a customer call. It’s gotten so bad lately that I'm really worried about losing my job.
Do you often have trouble focusing on tasks or frequently make careless mistakes, even outside of work situations?

Yes, it definitely happens outside of work too. At home, I'll start chores or DIY projects but bounce between them and leave them half-finished, and my wife constantly has to remind me about bills or appointments so I don't forget them. Even trying to just sit and watch a movie or read is hard because my mind drifts and I get too fidgety to stay put.
Do you often feel restless, as if you're driven by a motor, or find it hard to relax even when you're not busy?

Yes, absolutely. I get this buzzing inside whenever I have to sit still, and my family even jokes that I'm like a wind-up toy because I'm always bouncing from one thing to the next. Even when trying to relax and watch a movie with my wife, I can't just sit quietly and end up fidgeting or starting some noisy project.
